<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0232026-03-2016-37-13" status="unreviewed">bzhi pa zhar la mtshan nyid kyi skyon gyi rnam par dbye ba ni <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya pa</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">kha cig</rs> mtshan nyid tsam du mtshon pa'i mtshan nyid kyi rigs myi mthun ba mtshan nyid tsam yang ma yin ba dang | mtshon bya de la ltos nas mtshan nyid ma yin ba dang | mtshan
               <lb n="17a9"/>gzhi de la mtshon pa'i mtshan nyid ma yin ba ste gsum yin no zhes gsung ba ltar na | gtan tshigs tsam du mtshon pa'i rigs mi mthun gtan tshigs tsam yang ma yin ba dang | 'bras bu'i gtan tshigs ma yin ba dang mi dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs ma yin ba ste gsum yod par smra ba cis 'gog | </seg></TEI>
